prompt:
Two fixes to this PR (classic-laddie ollama->llama.cpp migration in hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix). Keep the change tightly scoped to these two things.

FIX 1 — persistent model cache (RUNTIME BUG). The PR only MENTIONS LLAMA_CACHE=/var/cache/llama-swap in a comment but never actually sets it. The nixpkgs services.llama-swap module runs DynamicUser=true, WorkingDirectory=/tmp, with no StateDirectory/CacheDirectory and no HOME/LLAMA_CACHE. So at runtime 'llama-server -hf' would try to write its ~20GB GGUF download under HOME=/var/empty (read-only) and FAIL on first model load — or dump into tmpfs /tmp and vanish on reboot. Fix by overriding the generated unit so downloads go to a persistent, writable, dynamic-user-owned dir:
    systemd.services.llama-swap.serviceConfig.CacheDirectory = "llama-swap";   # -> /var/cache/llama-swap, chowned to the DynamicUser
    systemd.services.llama-swap.environment.LLAMA_CACHE = "/var/cache/llama-swap";
Verify these actually land in the generated unit: build the unit and confirm CacheDirectory= and Environment=LLAMA_CACHE=... are present, e.g.
    nix eval --raw .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.systemd.services.llama-swap.serviceConfig.CacheDirectory
    nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.systemd.services.llama-swap.environment
(Adjust attribute paths if the module nests differently — confirm the override merges, not conflicts, with the module.) If the module already exposes an option for env or cache dir, prefer that over a raw systemd override, but the end state must be: a persistent writable cache dir that LLAMA_CACHE points at.

FIX 2 — COMMENT COMPRESSION (style). Patrick wants code comments EXTREMELY compressed / very high information density. The current ~20-line prose block above services.llama-swap (and any other verbose comments in this diff) must collapse to a few packed lines. Keep only the non-obvious WHY; drop anything the code plainly shows. Target density (example for the header block):
    # llama-swap fronts one RTX 4090 (24GB): one model loaded per request, idle-unloaded
    # (32B Q4_K_M + 8192 KV ~= 20GB -> no co-residency). CUDA llama.cpp invoked per-command,
    # not a standalone service, so llama-swap owns each llama-server lifecycle. Reuses
    # ollama's :11434, OpenAI API, identical model IDs; GGUFs pulled via -hf into LLAMA_CACHE.
    # Localhost-only; open-webui the sole consumer.
Apply the same terseness to the inline mkModel comment and the gemma substitution note (compress, don't delete the gemma-3-27b substitution fact). This terse-comment rule is a standing preference — apply it to any comment you touch.

VERIFY (synchronous only; do NOT start long builds/downloads and exit): nix flake check; nix eval the two attrs above to confirm the cache config; nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --dry-run. Then commit and push to the PR branch. Do NOT do a full real build (the coordinator runs that on-host). Update the PR body to replace the false 'CacheDirectory' claim with the now-accurate cache setup.
